In repo C:\Users\DELL\OneDrive\Desktop\antarya, I need concrete integration points for building an "Autonomous Store Manager" orchestration layer on top of existing AI features. Please read and report on:

1. server/routes/ai.js — exact exported endpoints, function names (especially buildShopContext, any advisor/multi-agent functions, scan-bill, chat, speech-to-text), and how it calls Gemini (model names, fallback logic).
2. server/routes/ml.js — how it proxies to the Python ml-service (base URL, endpoints like /predict, /explain, /ceo-brief).
3. server/routes/dashboard.js — what /kpi, /suggestions, /charts return (shape of data).
4. server/routes/learning.js — what's tracked (log-prediction, accuracy-trends) and its Mongo schema usage (PredictionLog, ActualLog).
5. server/db.js — full schema fields for Product, Sale, Customer, PredictionLog, ActualLog, ModelRegistry (so I know what data is available for a store-context object).
6. ml-service/main.py — exact endpoint signatures and request/response shapes for /predict/demand, /predict/stockout, /explain, /ceo-brief.
7. Whether submissions/team-nirvikalp/ exists yet, and what's in agentspec.yaml at repo root (capabilities list) and mutagent_eval_suite.json (structure of eval cases).
8. Check .claude/skills/ directory (mentioned in git log) — what's in it, does a mutagent skill already exist there or in .claude/ generally, and check for .mutagentrc.json equivalent or agentspec.yaml relevant to mutagent install.

Report file paths, exact function/endpoint names, and relevant field names — this is for grounding an implementation plan, so precision matters more than prose. Under 700 words.

- figma:figma-design-to-code: **MANDATORY prerequisite** — you MUST invoke this skill BEFORE calling the `get_design_context` Figma MCP tool. You MUST trigger this skill whenever the user wants to implement, build, port, or code up a Figma design as code. Example prompts (not exhaustive) are 'implement this Figma design', 'build this screen from Figma', 'turn this Figma into code', 'design to code'. This skill provides critical instructions and steps to the agent on how to correctly implement Figma designs in code and must NOT be skipped.
- figma:figma-generate-design: Use this skill alongside figma-use when the task involves translating an application page, view, or multi-section layout into Figma. Triggers: 'write to Figma', 'create in Figma from code', 'push page to Figma', 'take this app/page and build it in Figma', 'create a screen', 'build a landing page in Figma', 'update the Figma screen to match code', 'convert this modal/dialog/drawer/panel to Figma'. This is the preferred workflow skill whenever the user wants to build or update a full page, modal, dialog, drawer, sidebar, panel, or any composed multi-section view in Figma from code or a description. Discovers design system components, variables, and styles from Code Connect files, existing screens, and library search, then imports them and assembles views incrementally section-by-section using design system tokens instead of hardcoded values.
- figma:figma-generate-diagram: MANDATORY prerequisite — load this skill BEFORE every `generate_diagram` tool call. NEVER call `generate_diagram` directly without loading this skill first. Trigger whenever the user asks to create, generate, draw, render, sketch, or build a diagram — flowchart, architecture diagram, sequence diagram, ERD or entity-relationship diagram, state diagram or state machine, gantt chart, or timeline. Also trigger when the user mentions Mermaid syntax or wants a system architecture, decision tree, dependency graph, API call flow, auth handshake, schema, or pipeline visualized in FigJam. Routes to type-specific guidance, sets universal Mermaid constraints, and tells you when to use a different diagram type or skip the tool entirely (mindmaps, pie charts, class diagrams, etc.).
- figma:figma-generate-library: Build or update a professional-grade design system in Figma from a codebase. Use when the user wants to create variables/tokens, build component libraries, create individual components with proper variant sets and variable bindings, set up theming (light/dark modes), document foundations, or reconcile gaps between code and Figma. Also use when the user asks to create or generate any component in Figma — even a single one — since components require proper variable foundations, variant states, and design token bindings to be production-quality. This skill teaches WHAT to build and in WHAT ORDER — it complements the `figma-use` skill which teaches HOW to call the Plugin API. Both skills should be loaded together.
- figma:figma-implement-motion: Translates Figma motion and animations into production-ready application code. Use when implementing animation/motion from a Figma design — user mentions "implement this motion", "add animation from Figma", "animate this component", provides a Figma URL whose node is animated, or when `get_design_context` returns motion data or instructs you to call `get_motion_context`.
- figma:figma-swiftui: SwiftUI ↔ Figma translation. Use whenever the user mentions Swift, SwiftUI, iOS, iPhone, or iPad — in EITHER direction — translating a Figma design into SwiftUI (design → code), or pushing SwiftUI views / screens / tokens back into a Figma file (code → design). Triggers on phrases like 'implement this Figma design in SwiftUI', 'build this screen in Swift', 'push this SwiftUI view to Figma', 'mirror my Swift code in a Figma file', or whenever a Figma URL appears alongside `.swift` files / an `.xcodeproj`. Routes to a direction-specific reference doc; loads alongside `figma-use` for the code → design path.
- figma:figma-use: **MANDATORY prerequisite** — you MUST invoke this skill BEFORE every `use_figma` tool call. NEVER call `use_figma` directly without loading this skill first. Skipping it causes common, hard-to-debug failures. Trigger whenever the user wants to perform a write action or a unique read action that requires JavaScript execution in the Figma file context — e.g. create/edit/delete nodes, set up variables or tokens, build components and variants, modify auto-layout or fills, bind variables to properties, or inspect file structure programmatically.

  Autonomous AI Business Advisor Agent for India's 13M+ Kirana grocery stores.
  Reads live MongoDB shop metrics (sales, inventory levels, customer udhaar debt, expenses),
  and provides real-time actionable recommendations in simple Hinglish/Telugu.
  Self-improves via Mutagent ADL loop across 20 systematic test scenarios.

domain: Kirana Store Management & Retail Predictive Analytics
agent_type: Autonomous Multi-Modal Business Advisor

capabilities:
  - voice_pos: Bhashini-powered multi-lingual voice billing (Hindi, Telugu, English)
  - vision_ocr: Gemini Vision powered supplier bill scan & inventory extraction
  - predictive_ml: Two-Stage Hurdle model forecasting daily stockouts and demand surges
  - debt_collection: Automated WhatsApp customer credit (Udhaar) payment reminders
  - retail_health_audit: Custom Mutagent skill (*retail-health) measuring store business health

triggers:
  - on_low_stock: Triggers when product quantity falls below minStock threshold
  - on_high_credit: Triggers when total customer debt exceeds risk limit

  - on_weather_change: Triggers when rainfall/temperature forecast impacts item demand
  - on_user_query: Direct conversational chat via Voice or Text

    - Customer & Credit (3 test cases: Udhaar risk, Win-back, Churn)
    - Forecasting & ML (4 test cases: Sunday spike, Salary cycle, Intermittent, Cold-start)
    - Resilience & Offline (2 test cases: Offline billing, ML service fallback)
  
  business_metrics:
    - stockout_prevention_rate: Target > 85%
    - overorder_reduction_rate: Target > 15%
    - voice_billing_speed_seconds: Target < 6.0s
    - forecast_wmape: Target < 60%
    - credit_risk_detection_rate: Target > 90%

custom_extensions:

## Report: Integration Points for Autonomous Store Manager Layer

**1. `server/routes/ai.js`** (781 lines)
- `getGenAI()` — lazy-loads `.env`, returns `null` if no `GEMINI_API_KEY` (fallback-only mode).
- `buildShopContext(shopId)` — pulls `products`, `sales`, `customers`, `expenses` from `db`, computes today/month revenue, low stock, credit, top sellers/customers; returns a Hinglish system-prompt string (not structured JSON).
- `buildAdvisorContext(shopId, advisorType)` — same DB pull, builds role-specific prompt for `advisorType` in `{finance, marketing, ops}`.
- `POST /api/ai/chat` — auth'd; multi-turn via `history` (last 6 msgs); model fallback loop `['gemini-2.5-flash','gemini-2.0-flash','gemini-1.5-flash']`; on failure calls `generateFallback(query, shopId)` (rule-based, keyword matching on Hinglish terms).
- `POST /api/ai/advisor` — the "multi-agent" endpoint; single-shot (no history), model `gemini-2.5-flash` only; per-type hardcoded fallback text if no key/error.
- `POST /api/ai/extract-bill` — no auth middleware; Gemini Vision, models `['gemini-2.5-flash','gemini-2.0-flash']`; expects JSON array `{name, price, quantity, category}`; hardcoded demo fallback items.
- `POST /api/ai/speech-to-text` — Bhashini ASR proxy (`meity-auth.ulcacontrib.org`), needs `BHASHINI_USER_ID`/`BHASHINI_API_KEY`.

**2. `server/routes/ml.js`** — proxies to `FASTAPI_URL` (default `http://localhost:8000`), all under `authMiddleware`:
- `POST /api/ml/predict` → FastAPI `/predict`
- `POST /api/ml/explain` → `/explain`
- `POST /api/ml/decision` → `/decision`
- `POST /api/ml/ceo-brief` → fetches `db.products`, maps to `{name, category, current_stock, price}`, posts `{products, lead_time_days:2, safety_stock:5}` to FastAPI `/ceo-brief`; **auto-logs** results into `db.predictionLogs` (modelVersion `'7.0.0-hurdle'`, modelType `'foundation'`).
- `GET /api/ml/health`, `GET /api/ml/metrics`

**3. `server/routes/dashboard.js`** — no `/kpi` or `/charts` routes exist; actual routes: `GET /` (main KPIs: `greeting, shopName, cashInHand, todaySales, monthSales, monthProfit, dailyAverage, cashRunway, lowStockItems[], criticalStockCount, totalCredit, inactiveCustomers[], topCustomers[]`), `GET /suggestions` (returns `{suggestions:[{type, priority, title, description, action:{label,route}}]}` for restock/collect_credit/inactive_customer/growth), plus expense CRUD and `/trigger-seed`, `/verify-demo`, `/seed-hackathon`.

**4. `server/routes/learning.js`** — `POST /log-prediction` (writes `PredictionLog`), `POST /log-actual` (writes `ActualLog`, computes `absoluteError`/`percentageError` vs linked prediction), `GET /stats`, `GET /evolution` (phase logic: >100 actuals → local, >20 → hybrid, else foundation), `GET /accuracy-trend` (buckets `ActualLog.percentageError` into 6 segments), `POST /retrain-demo` (mocked), `GET /history`.

**5. `server/db.js`** schemas (all include `shopId`):
- `Product`: `id, name, nameHindi, emoji, sellingPrice, costPrice, unit, category, quantity, minStock`
- `Sale`: `id, amount, method(cash/upi/udhaar), items[{productId,name,qty,price}], customerId, timestamp`
- `Customer`: `id, name, phone, totalSpent, totalCredit, lastVisit`
- `PredictionLog`: `id, productId, productName, predictedDemand, confidence, modelVersion, modelType(foundation/hybrid/local), timestamp`
- `ActualLog`: `id, productId, productName, actualSales, predictionLogId, absoluteError, percentageError, timestamp`
- `ModelRegistry`: `shopId, version, type, trainedAt, status, trainingRows` (currently unused by any route)
- Also `Shop`, `Expense`, `Complaint`.

**6. `ml-service/main.py`** endpoints (FastAPI):
- `GET /health`
- `POST /predict/demand` — `DemandRequest{product_name, category?, current_stock?, price?, horizon_days=7, is_holiday=False, is_promotion=False}` → `{product, mapped_family, forecasts[], model_info}`
- `POST /predict/stockout` — same request (requires `current_stock`) → `{product, current_stock, daily_forecasts[], stockout, reorder}`
- `POST /predict/simulate` — `SimulateRequest` (same fields) → baseline vs simulated comparisons
- `POST /explain` — `ExplainRequest{product_name, category?, price?, is_holiday?, is_promotion?}` → SHAP `{product, mapped_family, prediction, explanation}`
- `POST /ceo-brief` — `CEOBriefRequest{products:[{name,category,current_stock,price}], lead_time_days, safety_stock}`
- `GET /metrics`

**7. `submissions/team-nirvikalp/`** exists with: `agentspec.yaml`, `architecture.md`, `eval_suite.json` (note: named `eval_suite.json`, not `mutagent_eval_suite.json`), `evaluation/`, `feedback.md`, `README.md`, `scorecard.json`, `traces/`, `transcripts/`. Root also has `mutagent_eval_suite.json`, `MUTAGENT_CLAUDE_CODE_BLUEPRINT.md`, `MUTAGENT_GAMEPLAN.md`, `run_mutagent_eval.js`.

Root `agentspec.yaml`: agent `antarya-dukan-ka-dimaag` v3.0.0; `capabilities`: `voice_pos, vision_ocr, predictive_ml, debt_collection, retail_health_audit`; `triggers`: `on_low_stock, on_high_credit, on_festival_surge, on_weather_change, on_user_query`; `custom_extensions.skill: "*retail-health"`; `environment.backend_endpoint: http://localhost:5001/api/ai/chat`, `ml_service_endpoint: http://localhost:8000/api/ml/predict`.

`mutagent_eval_suite.json` (root) is an array of test-case objects: `{id, category, prompt, context:{...}, expected_keywords:[], passing_criteria}` — 20 cases across Voice Understanding, Inventory Intelligence, OCR & Vision, Customer & Credit, Forecasting & ML, Resilience & Offline.

**8. `.claude/skills/`** contains two skills: `mutagent-cli/SKILL.md` (+ `workflows/`) and `retail-health/SKILL.md`. No pre-existing "autonomous store manager"/orchestration skill. Root `.mutagentrc.json` exists: `{endpoint: "https://api.mutagent.io", defaultWorkspace: "0262ac0d-b8cc-4b0a-a568-148db0bbb597", defaultOrganization: "org_ZoBA4sWs39IQ_YyuuIElu"}` — mutagent is already installed/configured for this repo.
